purpose: Post-hoc numerical tolerance refinement of the SXS:BBH:2123 native diagnostic. This tests stability, not physical accuracy or release qualification.
checks: Replay the primary native array hash at baseline; use direct complex waveforms on the same output grid without alignment or fit. Evaluate refined-to-strict against the stated budget and require complex L2 to decrease from baseline-to-refined, allowing 1e-12 roundoff.
